landing.tagline: Log your training as fast as you lift.
landing.subtitle: A gym tracker that keeps working when the signal doesn't. One tap per set, clear progress, and PRs detected automatically.
landing.f1Body: Last session's numbers are pre-filled. Just tick it and the rest timer starts.
landing.f2Body: Everything saves on your phone first and syncs when you're back online. No set gets lost.
landing.f3Body: Estimated 1RM, weekly volume, a training heatmap and automatic personal records.
landing.f4Body: Full Body, Upper/Lower and Push/Pull/Legs. Pick one and go.
landing.install: Add it to your home screen for an app-like experience.
